title: The Create Adventure [TCA]
description: A mod pack Built around the Create mod with its add-ons, QOL Features, World-Gen Ad-astra, and much more! Jump in on the adventure!
body:
The Create Adventure is a thrilling modpack designed around the innovative "Create" mod and its exciting add-ons, delivering endless mechanical creativity and contraptions! Immerse yourself in a world shaped by the stunning landscapes of mods like "Teralith," "Tectonic," and "Biomes of Plenty," which provide rich environments to explore and build in.

But the adventure doesn’t stop there—expand your horizons by traveling to distant planets with "Ad Astra," or cultivate your survival experience with the charming "Farmer's Delight." Whether you're automating factories, journeying through epic terrains, or crafting the perfect farm, The Create Adventure offers endless excitement. Jump in and get started!
